why: Adds the allowlisted system-action remove-lxd-snap (script, workflow allowlist x3, notify_run, docs row, registry test). Merging it is Tier 1: it changes nothing on the VM. RUNNING it is Tier 2 and has the operator's approval (popup ~10:25Z, verbatim 'Remove the LXD snap now (Recommended)', relayed by Manager 2026-11-28b). The script refuses if any lxd container or VM exists, removes only the lxd snap, and verifies the trader and web-api stay active.
